author: Kushal
problem: daily_mm lists the rainfall in mm on each day of a season, starting with day 0, and today is a day number in the list. Return the total rain over the seven days before today, not counting today (fewer days if the season is younger than that).
bug_description: Starts the window at today - 6 instead of today - 7, so once a week has passed it only sums the six days before today.

comments.accurate: Total rain over the seven days before today, not counting today
comments.wrong_behavior: Total rain over the last six full days, not counting today
comments.wrong_location: Window start verified; the slice end may need to include today's rain
